When did meeting your friends become something you had to squeeze into whatever time was left? 🥹

Between work, parenting and everything at home, friendships can quietly turn into months of “let’s plan something.”

Maybe that’s what we didn’t understand about the kitty-party aunties growing up. They had a regular reason to get together. A place to laugh, talk and be there for each other.

At Moms of Bangalore, we see how much those moments matter. Coming to your first meetup alone. Finding another mum who says, “Same here.” Going home with a new friend—and plans to meet again. ❤️

We’re a Bangalore moms’ community creating space for friendship, connection and a little time for yourself.

Because mothers need a village of their own, too.

📍A mom in Bangalore looking to make friends? Follow momsofblr and check the link in our bio to join us. Come alone, leave with a new mom friend. 🫶

#BangaloreMoms #MomFriends #BengaluruMoms #MomsMeetup #MotherhoodCommunity

What is our vision for this room? 🥹❤️

To fill it with Mamas! ✨

And this Garba workshop was exactly that. 💃🏻

While the mamas danced, learned Garba and had some much-needed me-time, the kids had their own playdate with their papas. 🛝👨‍👧

No rushing. No choosing between mom time and family time. Just a room full of women dancing, laughing, meeting new moms and creating memories together. ❤️

This is what Moms of Bangalore is all about — creating real experiences, building friendships and bringing moms together beyond Instagram. 🫶🏻

If you’re a mom in Bangalore and want to be part of our next meetup, workshop or playdate, come join our community! 💕

Moms of Bangalore won Best Community at the M‑Pact Awards! 🏆💛

Sakshi and Steffi held the awards on stage, but this recognition belongs to every mom who has helped build this village.

To the mom who came to a meetup on her own. To the one who welcomed her. To everyone who has shared a story, offered support, or made another mother feel a little less alone: this one is for you.

We started Moms of Bangalore to make motherhood less lonely. Seeing the friendships growing here means more to us than we can say. Thank you for showing up for each other, and for making this community what it is. 🥹

Here’s to all the moms in our village. We won this together. ✨

#MomsOfBangalore #BangaloreMoms #MomCommunity #MPactAwards

A little glimpse into what happens when Bangalore moms come together to celebrate. ✨💚

Our Festive Meetup by Moms of Bangalore was everything we love about our community — festive outfits, beautiful moms, endless conversations, lots of laughter and SO much fun! 🥂🌸

From a lovely High Tea experience ☕️ to dancing, fun games, gifts, surprises and plenty of time to just relax and enjoy ourselves — it was an afternoon well spent. 💃🏻🎁

And honestly, seeing everyone dressed up in their festive best and simply enjoying themselves was the highlight. 🥹✨

Because motherhood can get so busy, but sometimes you just need a few hours where you’re not *just* a mom — you’re YOU. ❤️

This is what Moms of Bangalore is all about — creating a space where moms can meet, make friends, celebrate, laugh and make memories together. 🫶🏻

And if you’re still not part of this community…

Girl, you’re missing out! 👀😂

Come join us for the next one. We promise there’s always something fun waiting for you. ✨

This Janmashtami, we’re looking back at a celebration filled with little Radhas and Krishnas, their beautiful Yashodas, tiny hands creating, moms dancing, and a room full of laughter. 💛

But beyond the festive outfits, music and activities, our favourite part was watching mothers connect, make new friends and find their village.

Because celebrations feel warmer when they’re shared—and motherhood feels lighter when you don’t have to do it alone. 🌼

Happy Janmashtami from our little Moms of Bangalore village! 🦚✨

📍The Bubble Room, Jayanagar, Bangalore

#JanmashtamiCelebration #MomsOfBangalore #BangaloreMoms #MotherhoodCommunity #KidsActivitiesBangalore BangaloreEvents MomCommunity KrishnaJanmashtami MakingMotherhoodLessLonely

Our very first Moms of Bangalore festive celebration was everything we hoped it would be and more. 🦚✨

From the moment they walked in, our moms embraced the theme beautifully — dressed as Yashodas, while our little ones came dressed as adorable Kanhas and Radhas. 💛

The day was filled with so much laughter, dancing, singing and fun activities, along with a beautiful art workshop where moms and kids got creative and painted Krishna together. 🎨 thanks for kalakriti_by_isha for helping us organise this. 

We also had the most amazing food, including delicious Awadhi phirni specially brought by Rukhsar - zaikaeawadhblr from our mom entrepreneur community. 🤍

A special shoutout to our photographer who captured beautiful Krishna-themed portraits of everyone — memories we’ll cherish for a long time. 📸

And of course, the gorgeous gift hampers curated by another wonderful mom entrepreneur and baker from our community - sweet_crust_by_tejaswini made the celebration even more special. 🎁

The beautiful space at The thebubbleroom.in was the perfect setting for our celebration. A special thank you to Harshita for making this possible and welcoming us so warmly. 🌸

Most importantly, it was a room full of moms connecting, laughing, celebrating and simply enjoying themselves — exactly what Moms of Bangalore is all about. ❤️

Here’s to many more celebrations, memories and moments together! 🥰
